%TEI.header.dtd

TEI.header.dtd (TEI header) identifies the file containing element and attribute list declarations for the TEI header.
Note

This entity is included in all TEI DTDs.
Declaration <!ENTITY % TEI.header.dtd PUBLIC '-//TEI P4//ELEMENTS TEI Header//EN' 'teihdr2.dtd' >
